scope.included: Scythe 2016 base/core multiplayer for 2–5 players, full frozen candidate material gameplay claims and important omissions.
scope.method: Read the full new candidate and compare throughout with the complete authoritative source already read in this continuing source-only review; re-read PDF pp. 21, 23, 27, 28 for explicit victory-star branches and timing. Source-only production, mat/recruit, six structure tile and scoring diagrams have been visually inspected in this review. No questions/keys/readers/grades/coverage/prior reports accessed; no existing files edited.

checked_claims.claims_and_assessment: A non-Saxony victory with zero or one previous combat stars must place one; with two places none. Source requires winning combat star if fewer than two and globally makes achieved stars mandatory. This applies to either attacker or defender. Further combat remains legal after ordinary cap.

Saxony must place one star after every combat victory while tokens remain, with no two-combat-star cap and only six available total. New clause agrees with Dominate and immediate sixth-star end. It does not allow declining an eligible star or fighting past the game end.

Both sides pay dial power and discard used cards after reveal; combat outcome includes control, retreat/resource retention and attacker worker-popularity effects. Eligible victory star can end the game, preventing later combats/encounters and subsequent actions; pending attacks undone. Source combat resolution and end exceptions retained.

Read complete frozen candidate against complete authoritative source already read in this continuing source-only review. Rechecked quantities, costs/benefits, destinations, permissions, all factions, encounters/Factory, recruits, all six tile diagrams, immediate ending and scoring. No important in-scope omission identified.

Correct faction component quantities/types, greatest final fortune, clockwise individual turns/no rounds/sixth-star ending; shuffled decks, players+1 Factory cards with unused unseen, random tile, eleven encounters, supply, random mats and seating, correct track/card/coin sources and two objectives, all starting locations and empty one-time slots, lowest numbered Player Mat starts.

Combat hand count public except commitment concealment during combat until reveal; contents secret, objective contents secret until reveal; coins not hidden but total need not be disclosed. No conflict with mandatory reveal/discard.

Distinct previous-turn section except Rusviet including Factory; optional top then bottom, once each for all factions, either/both/neither. Full exposed red cost before optional green benefits, top can fund bottom, dead turns and noninteractive bottom-choice overlap.

Home bases never territories and normal return/build/deploy disallowed with setup/retreat/Wayfare exceptions, inactive expansion placeholders. Unit or unoccupied own structure control, enemy worker controls building/resources, defender temporarily controls pending battle; owner keeps abilities except uncontrolled Mill. Only four resource types not workers, spend any controlled territory for remote actions to supply, resources otherwise remain, unlimited supply/stacking.

Two different sequential units one step or one coin before upgrades; all carry resources, only mechs workers not characters, carried workers may also move themselves. Default river/lake restriction, shoreline lake rule, tunnel adjacency and own Mine even enemy controlled with normal entry restrictions. Speed plastic-unit extra step and intermediate load/unload; tunnel travel costs step.

Enemy structure-only entry legal, worker independent hostile-entry restrictions. Enemy worker/plastic entry stops character/mech and encounter stops character for turn; undefended worker retreat immediate/home/resources left, one popularity each down to zero, not combat. Full Move then attacker-ordered combats then encounter before subsequent bottom; lost contested encounter leaves token.

One coin for two power or one card pre-upgrade with correct reshuffle/exhaustion; one coin for two arbitrary resources or popularity, resource destination controlled worker territory, no resource Trade all workers home. Monument popularity and Armory power correctly assigned.

Full exposed pre-production cost, up to two controlled distinct territories before upgrade, per-worker matching terrain token placed there. Correct mountain/metal tundra/oil farm/food forest/wood village/worker, no lake/Factory output. Optional left-to-right new workers after payment expose future costs only, never returned to mat.

Controlled Mill extra production territory, Mill worker-equivalent output alongside actual workers, may produce without actual workers. Current base two plus Mill up to three, upgraded three plus Mill up to four, respecting terrain output and control.

Oil/metal/wood/food mapping correct, explicit exposed Upgrade/Deploy quantities and varying mat costs/coins; optional coins, completed paid actions still grant coins/recruits, announce action. Upgrade effect top benefit and bottom reduction retains pay-first sequence, cube any green to empty bracketed red, never solid-border red.

Normal placement controlled worker territory, no lake/home base, unlocked mech ability all mechs and character not workers; one structure total per territory incl opponents, Factory allowed, permanent/no opponent ability use. Armory, Monument, Mill and Mine effects correct including Mine Factory movement and enemy control.

Any recruit to any empty permanent one-time slot for two power/coins/popularity/cards; ongoing original section one power Upgrade, coin Deploy, popularity Build, card Enlist. Self and immediate neighbors matching bottom, active-left-right, two-player opponent once, no top/Factory/encounter triggers, sixth-star cutoff.

Rusviet repeats sections incl Factory, Crimea once per turn one card as one resource independent of value, Nordic workers rivers not lakes, Polania two different encounter choices from one card any order with first gain paying second, Saxony retains other objective and no normal combat/objective cap within available stars.
Rusviet farms/villages, Crimea farms/tundra, Nordic and Saxony forests/mountains, Polania villages/mountains, plastic scope only; all factions unlock Speed.

Underpass controlled mountains/tunnels/Mine, Disarm two opponent track power before tunnel/Mine battle once per combat; Township controlled villages/Factory, Peoples Army one additional card total with worker and plastic required, correct example.

Seaworthy lake movement and adjacent-lake retreat incl carried workers; Artillery one power paid for opponent loss two once per combat; Wayfare own/inactive bases incl expansion not active enemies; Scout one random enemy card before combat once per combat.

Submerge lake movement and any lake to another, Camaraderie only aggressive combat win not undefended worker displacement; no abandoned workers/resources on lake, workers need mech to leave, no lake build/deploy, lake battles possible, no Polania Nordic retreat exception.

Zero power/popularity attacks allowed, attacker ability first; simultaneous secret dial 0..min(7,current), optional card per plastic plus Rusviet even zero dial; simultaneous reveal/sum, attacker ties. Both pay dial track power and discard every played card face-up, no extra card-value track deduction.

Winner controls territory/resources; all losing units retreat home leaving resources with Nordic exception. Winning attacker loses popularity per enemy worker incl lake-carried, winning defender none and Polania exception. Loser draws one card only for positive revealed dial/card power; zero-total loser none.

Character-only encounters after all Move/combats, lost battle token remains, card/art shown and thematic capitals aloud, affordable required choice except Polania, full cost optional benefit, all resources/units/buildings to encounter, no normal costs/mat/recruit bonuses, face-down deck bottom. Every character first Factory finish must choose one permanent card/no swap, fifth section optional top then bottom and normal repeat/Rusviet, no corresponding mat benefits, bottom one unit two steps or Speed plastic three with normal stops/Mine.

Own-turn reveal before/after top/bottom with full requirements then, may wait, ordinary one star/both cards bottom-deck versus Saxony other retained. Informal agreements unenforceable, only coins tangible with tournament restriction, initiated combat cannot be cancelled.

checked_claims.topic: Scoring and all six structure tiles
checked_claims.claims_and_assessment: Held coins, stars, territories, complete pooled resource pairs and selected structure bonus. Rates popularity 0–6 3/2/1, 7–12 4/3/2, 13–18 5/4/3. Factory THREE TOTAL, other controlled land/lakes one, home bases none, sum before rate; pair floor and no workers/cards. Structure bonus survives enemy control without territory/resource scoring rights. Adjacent tunnels 1/2–3/4–5/6 pay 2/4/6/9; lakes/encounters 1/2–3/4–5/6–7 same; on tunnels 1/2/3–4 pay 2/4/6; longest straight row and combined farms/tundra 1/2/3/4 pay 2/4/6/9. Unique features once, Mine exclusion, removed encounters count, rivers no break, zero zero. Tie order workers+mechs+structures, power, popularity, resources, territories, stars.

important_omission_review: No important in-scope omission identified. Exact mat-dependent values correctly refer to exposed physical mat boxes. Exhaustive global inventory, combat-card frequencies, strategy/narrative and optional teaching notes are acceptable summary omissions.
limitations: Supplied base-rulebook scope only; no external FAQ, later revision or component-card corpus audited.
conclusion: PASS for recorded candidate-repair-08 hash. Explicit ordinary zero/one-versus-two combat-star branches and Saxony mandatory available-token victory awards are source-supported, including attacker/defender eligibility, ordinary cap, continued-combat legality and immediate sixth-star ending. No material contradiction or important core multiplayer omission found.
